verdict.rationale: Unit's own API docs state that an OpenAPI 3.0 specification for the Unit API is available, linked to the official unit-finance/openapi-unit-sdk repository. A downloadable Postman v2.1 collection is also hosted on unit.co. The probe 404s on conventional unit.co spec paths do not contradict this, because the spec is distributed through the official repo rather than at a well-known URL. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that the linked spec downloads and is complete/current, and a spec hosted at a stable, discoverable URL on the vendor's own domain.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
